title: The symmetric MMP mouth clock is not an independent boundary mode
description:
In the fixed-flux spherical sector of the Maldacena-Milekhin-Popov wormhole, the symmetric proper-mouth clock is not an independent boundary mode once both asymptotic clocks are normalized. The classification is already known. This deposit records that obstruction and does not claim a new theorem.

No shortcut, formation, propulsion, occupancy, TRL, launch, seed, or revenue result is claimed. No Lean certificate is claimed.
